notes.title: Update v.1.05
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Added "Use system cursor" setting
- Fixed overflowing titles for user-created puzzles in the Workshop

If you find any issues let me know in the Community Hub!

tags.feature: - Added "Use system cursor" setting

tags.bug: - Fixed overflowing titles for user-created puzzles in the Workshop

notes.title: v.1.04 - German localization
notes.content:
The game is now also available in [b]German[/b], many thanks to Pashalis Papadopoulos for his work!

If you find any issues let me know in the Community Hub!

Changelog:
- Added German translation
- Empty lines are automatically filled with Xs (v.1.04b)
- Added option to toggle autofilling of empty lines (v.1.04c)

tags.feature: - Added German translation
- Empty lines are automatically filled with Xs (v.1.04b)
- Added option to toggle autofilling of empty lines (v.1.04c)

notes.title: Update v.1.02/1.03
notes.content:
Here's the changelog of versions v.1.02 and 1.03:

[*] Russian localization added (many thanks to Anton Slidding)
[*] The savegame is stored in the game's folder for users who don't use Steam Cloud and want to backup their progress
[*] Updated the app runtime the game runs on
[*] Fixed an interaction bug in the various pause screens (1.02b)
[*] Fixed a minor visual issue in the gamepad settings screen (1.02b)
[*] Enabled Steam Cloud saves (1.02c)
[*] Improved puzzle grid scaling and rendering (1.02d)
[*] Puzzles can now be zoomed in by pressing F5 (1.02e)
[*] Improved puzzle grid scaling and zooming (1.02f)
[*] Fixed launching issue on Windows7 (1.03)
[*] Added category and puzzle titles on mouse over in Classic mode (1.03)
[*] Fixed minor puzzle thumbnail generation issue introduced in 1.03 (1.03b)
[*] Zoom status persists across puzzles (1.03c)

If you find any issues let me know in the Community Hub!

notes.title: Update v.1.01
notes.content:
Here's the changelog of version v.1.01:

[*] French localization added (many thanks to @EnzoPiou)
[*] Changed how hints are grayed out, now they should behave better in different scenarios
[*] Fixed an empty tile in the Mosaic Puzzle "The Apprentice"
[*] Added a couple of tentative fixes aimed to solve issues experienced by some users

If you find any issues let me know in the Community Hub!
